literal: The nobility that does not consent to begging even at a time of lacking resources is indeed of the nature that all space cannot contain.
translation: The nobility of character that refuses to resort to begging, even when one is completely destitute, is so vast that the entire world cannot contain its greatness.
modern: வறுமை வந்த காலத்திலும் பிறரிடம் இரந்து கேட்க உடன்படாத சான்றாண்மை, இவ்வுலகம் முழுதும் கொள்ள முடியாத அளவு பெருமையுடையதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet praises the supreme dignity of self-respect. The word 'சால்பு' refers to the perfect nobility of character. Even when a person has absolutely no resources ('இடம் இல்லாக் காலும்'), they refuse to stoop to begging ('இரவு ஒல்லா'). The poet declares that the glory of such unyielding dignity is so immense that the entire world ('இடமெல்லாம்') is not large enough to contain it ('கொள்ளாத் தகைத்தே').
